summary: Challenge to High Court's interference in CIRP; resolution plan approved by CoC on 11.02.2020; delay of nearly three years in filing writ petition; alternate statutory remedies under IBC availed by respondent; principles of natural justice claim rejected due to laches; High Court's exercise of jurisdiction under Article 226 improper; IBC as a complete code with in-built remedies; interference with CIRP undermines legal discipline; NCLAT and Supreme Court precedents cited upholding finality of CoC decisions.
legal_provisions_cited: IBBI (Insolvency Resolution Process for Corporate Persons) Regulations, 2016 Reg.19
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; impugned judgment of High Court setting aside resolution plan quashed; dismissal of writ petition affirmed; resolution plan and declaration of successful resolution applicant restored.
